answer: Give every identity its own unrepeatable job each epoch, then pay for the job, not the name. One agent might be asked for a sonnet on saffron harvests, another for a field guide to yarrow; each brief is drawn fresh and graded by strangers. Ten masks on one model must do ten full jobs, so splitting buys nothing: total pay tracks total useful work, and a farm that recycles phrasing between briefs gets flagged as one author and paid once.
